selection.rule: On both validation and held-out test: at least four small table annotations; tiled small-table recall +0.05 and overall recall +0.02, precision decrease at most 0.04; full-frame person recall and precision decrease at most 0.03.
selection.note: Model selection involved the COCO validation split. Test is a held-out image subset, but has also been used to check the search pipeline. Neither set is the user restaurant. Cross-frame confirmation is not measured by this single-frame benchmark.

baseline.dataset: 128 images from COCO val subset (64 with tables, 64 without)
baseline.note: Pretrained weights fixed, PyTorch approximates browser crop processing; evaluates one frame, before cross-frame stability and zone expansion. User video not evaluated.
